Independent spacing proof and alternate derivation from the semicircle minimum tail
correctness.rationale: Anchor the cyclic gap list at a specified sampled point, not at the first point after a fixed coordinate cut. Conditional on its angle the other n-1 rotated angles are independent uniform, so their order-statistic spacings are Dirichlet(1,...,1). This anchoring leaves the cyclic statistic unchanged. Outside the half-circle tie null set, original containment means every gap is <1/2, and deleting a vertex merges its two adjacent gaps. Pivotality therefore requires the merged pair to sum to >1/2. Two disjoint pairs cannot both do this, and any three edges of a cycle of length n>=4 include a disjoint pair. The Beta(2,n-2) tail of an adjacent sum at 1/2 is n/2^(n-1); removing the two disjoint cases with an individual long gap gives per-gap-edge probability (n-2)/2^(n-1). In an adjacent joint event with common gap x<1/2, subtract 1/2-x from each neighboring gap; the residual simplex has total x, so the original neighbors are automatically <1/2 and the remaining gaps are at most x. The joint probability is (n-1) integral_0^(1/2) x^(n-2) dx=2^(-(n-1)). The n joint events are disjoint and exhaust K=2; the expectation and normalization then give K=1 and K=0. Wendel noncontainment is n/2^(n-1), and must be subtracted from K=0 before conditioning on containment. This gives conditional robustness zero at n=4 and 1/11 at n=5. Positive radial scaling does not change any of the containment predicates. The prior-law derivation in the originality assessment independently reproduces the probability algebra.
residual_risks: The formula is an almost-sure statement under the specified continuous directions; it does not classify tied, antipodal or degenerate configurations. Unconditional K=0 includes initially failing samples and is not the same event as robustness.

evidence: The Hodges tail gives Pr(K>0)=Pr(T=1)=n(n-3)/2^(n-1). For a distinguished omission, noncontainment of the full sample implies noncontainment of the reduced sample; therefore its pivotality probability is the difference of the Wendel noncontainment probabilities for n-1 and n, equal to (n-2)/2^(n-1). Summation gives E[K]=n(n-2)/2^(n-1). The sole support observation needed is that three merged adjacent-gap pairs on a cycle of length at least four contain disjoint pairs, so they cannot simultaneously exceed 1/2.
claim_vs_prior_implication.reasoning: For K supported on {0,1,2}, Pr(K=2)=E[K]-Pr(K>0)=n/2^(n-1); Pr(K=1)=Pr(K>0)-Pr(K=2)=n(n-4)/2^(n-1); the complement gives Pr(K=0). Conditional robustness is Pr(T>=2)/Pr(T>=1), likewise an immediate consequence. No computation of marked joint spacings or extra prior label-multiplicity law is needed. The elementary support observation does not leave a distinct substantive exact spectrum.

evidence: Section 2.3 of arXiv:1804.00286 defines the half-circle count scan and attributes its exact finite-sample distribution to Hodges (1955). The documented Hodges–Ajne statistic T is the minimum semicircle count. With no antipodal or coincident directions, one can choose the diameter off the sample; then T equals n minus the maximum semicircle count, and equals planar Tukey depth at zero.
equivalent_formulations.reasoning: Containment fails exactly at T=0. Deletion can make containment fail iff some separating half-circle contains all but at most one point, i.e. T<=1. Thus robustness is exactly T>=2, and K>0 exactly T=1; the definition sets K=0 on T=0. Counting triangles (simplicial depth) alone is not equivalent, whereas the semicircle scan is the exact statistic for the robustness part.

originality.rationale: The mathematical law is correct but is covered by the classical Hodges–Ajne exact semicircle tail together with an elementary first-moment and support calculation. In particular the robustness probability is a direct substitution, and the entire three-mass pivotal spectrum follows, not just one of its entries. This is demonstrated prior implication, not rejection for unavailable papers or an assertion that Hodges used the same pivotal-count wording.
residual_risks: The original Hodges and Ajne full texts were not read; the exact prior law and its attribution are supported by the inspected sources named above. The inaccessible same-day simplicial-depth result may add related coverage but is not the reason for failure. This review shows implication and does not claim to locate the first use of the pivotal terminology.

value.rationale: Deletion resilience of a random hull is a natural question, and distinguishing one from two pivotal vertices is interpretable. But for this frozen setting the robustness part just changes the threshold in a classical exact scan statistic, and the remaining masses follow from a first-moment subtraction and an elementary cycle observation. The standalone support observation does not establish a genuinely distinct valuable remainder for repair under the exact-invariant standard.
residual_risks: This judgment is confined to the frozen single-deletion planar uniform-direction theorem, not possible joint laws for marked pivotal positions or beyond-single-deletion settings.
